bio: Ivresse is a warm trendy establishment that sports two different vibes. The friendly bistro rolls out a lineup of staples of the likes of grilled bone marrow or mushroom and smoked garlic risotto. The excellent restaurant stars a parade of spot-on dishes that are presented in a succulent menu with a focus on sustainability, local producers and fresh premium ingredients. Veggies and gutsy, full-bodied sauces have clearly been cast in the leading roles of this culinary revue. Fans of organic and natural wines will be enchanted by what is on offer in both venues....
